name: maven-test-explorer-bridge
description: Bridges Maven/Surefire test results into the VS Code Testing sidebar.

commands.title: Maven: Copy Maven Command for Test

mavenTestExplorer.mavenExecutable.description: Path to the Maven executable (e.g. 'mvn' or '/usr/local/bin/mvn').

mavenTestExplorer.defaultCommand.description: Maven goals to run when executing tests (e.g. 'clean test').

mavenTestExplorer.defaultProfiles.description: Maven profiles to activate by default (e.g. ["dev", "ci"]).

mavenTestExplorer.additionalArgs.description: Additional arguments appended to every Maven command (e.g. '-Denv=dev01 -Dheadless=false').

mavenTestExplorer.reportGlobs.description: Glob patterns for Surefire/Failsafe XML report files.

mavenTestExplorer.watchReports.description: Automatically update Test Explorer when report XML files change.

mavenTestExplorer.clearReportsBeforeRun.description: Delete existing surefire-reports before running tests to prevent stale results.

mavenTestExplorer.testClassCommandTempla.description: Template for running a single test class. Placeholders: {maven}, {profiles}, {args}, {className}.

mavenTestExplorer.testMethodCommandTempl.description: Template for running a single test method. Placeholders: {maven}, {profiles}, {args}, {className}, {methodName}.

mavenTestExplorer.multiModuleMode.description: How to handle multi-module Maven projects. 'auto' detects automatically.

mavenTestExplorer.showOutputChannel.description: Reveal the Maven Test Explorer output channel when a test run starts.

mavenTestExplorer.autoRefreshOnSave.description: Automatically refresh the test tree when Java test files are created, deleted, or saved.

mavenTestExplorer.showStats.description: Show pass/fail aggregate counts next to each node in the test tree.

mavenTestExplorer.statsFormat.description: Format string for aggregate stats shown on test tree nodes. Available placeholders: {passed} — passed count, {failed} — failed + error count, {error} — error count (raw), {skipped} — skipped count, {total} — total count.
